summary: KTTZ-FM is a public radio station at 89.1 FM in Lubbock, Texas. It is owned by Texas Tech University. The station broadcasts a public radio format featuring classical and jazz music along with programming from National Public Radio.
one_line: KTTZ-FM is a Texas Tech University-owned public radio station at 89.1 FM in Lubbock, Texas, airing classical, jazz and NPR programming.
